# Frequency annealing applies low-pass and dynamic high-pass filters progressively [S1]

The evidence explicitly states in the notes and passages that the technique applies a low-pass filter (Hl) and a dynamic high-pass filter (Hh) to extract low-to-high frequency components progressively. Specifically, the notes mention: 'Apply a low-pass filter Hl and a dynamic high-pass filter Hh to extract low-to-high frequency components progressively.' and 'Use frequency annealing to progressively regularize from low-frequency signals to high-frequency signals'. The passages also confirm: 'With low-pass filter Hl and dynamic high-pass filter Hh , low-to-high frequency components are progressively leveraged...' and 'FreGS introduces a novel frequency annealing technique to achieve progressive frequency regularization... annealing the regularization progressively from low-frequency signals to high-frequency signals'.
supported
